question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 10 \\ -17\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 10 \\ -17\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 5 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 & 10 \\ 4 & -2 & 3 & -17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 20 \\ 4 & -2 & 3 & -17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 20 \\ 0 & -10 & 3 & -37\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 20 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=5 \\ 5{x}_{2}=20 \\ 3{x}_{3}=3.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second and third equations, we get ${x}_{2}=4$ and  ${x}_{3}=1$, respectively. Substituting ${x}_{2}=4$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}+2(4)=5\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-3.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

Finally, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=(-3)+4+1=2.
$$
